target: Technisys S.A. (Cyberbank cloud-native core banking platform)

deal_value.notes: All-stock: ~84 million SoFi shares with aggregate value of ~$1.1B based on 20-trading-day VWAP ended February 15, 2022; actual value floated with SOFI share price through closing

calculable.calculation: $1,100M all-stock consideration / ~$70M expected CY2021 Technisys revenue = ~15.7x
inputs: ~$1.1B all-stock deal value (~84M shares at 20-day VWAP) — SoFi press release / 8-K exhibit, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001818874/000181887422000014/exhibit991_8-k2222022.htm

Technisys expected to deliver approximately $70M of revenue in calendar-year 2021 — announcement-period press coverage, https://www.fool.com/investing/2022/02/25/will-sofis-11b-acquisition-of-technisys-pay-off/
calculable.caveats: The ~$70M CY2021 revenue is a press-reported expectation for a private company, not an audited or company-filed figure; deal value was stock-based and moved with SOFI's share price between announcement and close

notes: Source row had parties swapped ('Technisys / Sofi'); verified SoFi Technologies is the acquirer and Technisys the target, announced February 22, 2022, closed Q2 2022. No multiple published in the press release or investor deck coverage found; SoFi instead disclosed forward synergy guidance ($500-800M cumulative incremental revenue through 2025). Implied ~15.7x rests on a press-reported ~$70M CY2021 revenue estimate, hence partially_calculable rather than calculable.
